journey.name: Try It locked routes to Settings
journey.description: Verifies that the Try It tab shows the locked empty state when neither the Claude API key nor YouCam credentials are configured, and that its call-to-action navigates to Settings. The locked copy now mentions both providers. Start state: fresh install with no keys configured.

actions.action: Tap the "TRY IT" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Try It screen shows the locked state: the "Analyze & try things on" title, a description mentioning connecting Claude or YouCam, and an "Open Settings" button.
Verify the app navigates to the Settings screen, showing the "Settings" heading and the "Claude API Key" row.
